newsitem.title: USA: Wrigley sales up on international gains.
newsitem.headline: Wrigley sales up on international gains.

text.p: Wm. Wrigley Jr Co said Tuesday that its third quarter sales of $462 million rose seven percent from a year ago, reflecting international volume gains and some selective selling price increases.
The gain in international sales, however, was partially offset by the translation of results to a stronger U.S. dollar.

Earlier, Wrigley reported third quarter earnings of $0.53 a share, after a charge of just under $1 million related to the closure of a factory in Santa Cruz, Calif. A year ago it earned $0.50 a share.
The factory closure and related costs also cut year-to-date earnings by about $12 million after tax, Wrigley added.
The company earned $1.52 for the first nine-months of the year, down from $1.53 a year ago. Excluding the factory closure charge, 1996 year-to-date earnings were up $0.09 a share, Wrigley said.
